incentives.title: Tesla's 50 000 kr "Tesla-bonus" on Model Y RWD has ended
incentives.text: Tesla removed the 50 000 kr bonus it introduced in April; Model Y RWD went back from 449 900 to 499 900 kr (Allt om Elbil, 4 Nov 2026 — Tesla's own list price is 499 990 kr per Bilissimo/kostnader.se).

incentives.title: Elbilspremien (state EV support) — Model Y not eligible
incentives.text: Since 18 Mar 2026 you can apply for elbilspremien, up to 1 300 kr/month for 3 years; means-tested, rural areas only, and the car must cost at most 450 000 kr. Every Model Y version is above the cap now that the bonus is gone.
